subject: The 3AM moment 600 users beat
preview_text: Here's what happened when 600+ people opened Fresh Start at 3AM instead of texting their ex.
body_paragraphs: Last night, while you were sleeping, 37 users opened Fresh Start at 3AM. They didn't text their ex. They didn't spiral. They used Emergency Mode and felt the urge to reach out drop by 60%. You're still here, reading this. They're already 24 hours further into their no-contact streak.

Here's the thing: 600+ people have used Fresh Start to cut their recovery time by 40%. That's not a stat — it's 600 humans who woke up today feeling a little less broken. They did the work. They tracked their mood, journaled through the pain, and let the AI therapist talk them down from ledges. You have the same tool in your pocket.

Your no-contact streak is still at zero. But it doesn't have to be. Open the app now, start your streak, and see the difference 24 hours makes. The Emergency Mode is already there for when 3AM hits again — and it will.
Tap 'Start No-Contact Streak' in the app. That's it. One tap. You deserve to be one of those 600.
P.S. The first 24 hours are the hardest. After that, your streak becomes your armor. Open Fresh Start and put it on.
